# Scribd

> > Scribd is a digital library and document-sharing platform offering 300M+ documents, ebooks, and audiobooks through subscription services including Everand and Slideshare.

Scribd operates as both a subscription service for curated content (including partnerships with Wiley and For Dummies series) and a community document-sharing platform where users can upload and access educational materials, tutorials, and guides across diverse topics. The platform is accessible via web and mobile apps (Android/iOS).

## Key Topics

- Scribd
- Everand
- Slideshare
- Digital library
- Document sharing
- Subscription service

## Platform Overview

- [Scribd: Home to the world's documents](https://scribd.com): Homepage: 300M+ documents across diverse topics & categories
- [What is Scribd?](https://scribd.com/what-is-scribd): Overview of Scribd's 300M+ document library & subscription service
- [About Us](https://scribd.com/about.vbhtml): Company overview: Everand, Scribd, Slideshare & Fable platforms
- [Choose a Plan](https://scribd.com/pmp/plans): Subscription plans for audiobooks, ebooks & documents with free trial
- [60-Day Free Trial](https://scribd.com/promo/60daytrial): 60-day free trial promotion page with account creation

## Document Library

- [Documents: Explore & Upload for Free](https://scribd.com/docs): Browse community-uploaded documents in finance, tax forms & guides
- [Categories: Documents](https://scribd.com/docs/categories): Document category browser for community uploads

## Software & Design Tutorials

- [Adobe Photoshop 2023 A-Z Tutorial Guide by Helen Brooks](https://scribd.com/document/683696760/Adobe-Photoshop-2023-a-Z-Tutorial-Guide-by-Helen-Brooks): Photoshop 2023 A-Z guide by Helen Brooks with shortcuts (312 pages)
- [Microsoft Word Training Manual](https://scribd.com/document/328495852/MS-Word-Training-Manual-Complete-pdf): Complete MS Word training manual covering editing, formatting & features
- [Beginner's Guide to Adobe Illustrator](https://scribd.com/document/684452335/The-Complete-Beginners-Guide-to-Adobe-Il): Adobe Illustrator beginner course: interface, tools & vector design
- [Canva Made Simple: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://scribd.com/document/676777855/Canva-Basics-Guide-PDF): Canva beginner tutorial: account setup, templates & editing techniques
- [MS Project Tutorial Guide](https://scribd.com/doc/153949935/MS-Project-Tutorial-pdf): MS Project tutorial: tasks, Gantt charts, resources & critical path

## Technical & Engineering Guides

- [STAR-CCM+ User Guide: Tutorial Overview](https://scribd.com/document/360466374/StarCCM-Tutorial-pdf): STAR-CCM+ CFD simulation tutorial: setup, geometry import & wind tunnel
